extracted.intended_audience: authors and writers seeking literary agents or agent-directory resources
extracted.subtask_description: Locate and evaluate literary agents at International Creative Management (ICM) and prepare submission materials; the page is an agency profile and directory-access landing page with resources and coaching offerings for authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred query letter methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Agent profiles include 'Preferred query letter methods (email, online form, postal mail)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow each agent's stated preferred method of query submission (email, online form, or postal mail) when contacting them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use up-to-date/accurate directories
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning: 'Most literary agency directories (print and online) are outdated, incomplete, and riddled with mistakes.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely on outdated directories to find agents; use a current, accurate directory (the site urges registering for its Directory of Literary Agents to avoid hurting your chances).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by book genre/category
rubrics_metrics.description: The directory lets you 'Search the directory by book genre/category (more than 100 categories)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target agents who represent your specific genre or category rather than contacting randomly; use genre/category filters to find relevant agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider AAR membership status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AAR (Association of Authors' Representatives) membership status listed in profiles as one data point when evaluating an agent's credibility or professionalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use complete agent contact/profile information
rubrics_metrics.description: Profiles include 'Agent bios for all agents', 'Personal email addresses', 'Mailing addresses', 'Agent photos', 'A link to the ... website', and 'A map to the office'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer agents whose profiles provide complete, up-to-date contact and profile information; such completeness reduces risk of contacting the wrong person or using the wrong channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target agents by office/location
rubrics_metrics.description: Directory and pages reference offices and locations (New York, Los Angeles, London; and many city/region pages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider an agent's office location when relevant (e.g., for in-person meetings, local market knowledge, or rights handling). Use location filters if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Development (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Book Development' as a support area provided in coaching/consulting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and refine the manuscript's structure, content, and market positioning as part of readiness to approach agents; authors can seek coaching in this area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query Letter (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Query Letter' as a support area provided in coaching/consulting and offers a 'Write a Query Letter' resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A strong query letter is critical; authors should craft queries tailored to agent preferences and can use offered resources or coaching to improve them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Synopsis (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Book Synopsis' as a coaching/support area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a concise, clear synopsis suitable for agent review; consider coaching help to produce industry-standard synopses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book Proposal (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Book Proposal' as a coaching/support area (particularly relevant for nonfiction).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For nonfiction authors, produce a professional book proposal; use coaching to ensure it meets agents' expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author Platform (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Author Platform' as a support area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop and present an author platform (audience, marketing reach, social presence) when approaching agents and publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent Selection (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Agent Selection' among its coaching/support services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use objective criteria (genre fit, track record, AAR status, submission preferences, contract terms) and coaching guidance when choosing among potential agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process/Strategy (author support area)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Process/Strategy' as a coaching/support service to help authors navigate agent search and submission workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt a deliberate strategy and submission process (target list, timing, follow-up) rather than ad hoc querying; consider professional coaching for strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Troubleshooting & Miscellaneous author support
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Troubleshooting' and 'Miscellaneous' as support areas offered to authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek targeted help for specific problems (e.g., repeated rejections, agent communication issues) and miscellaneous concerns via coaching or resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider coaches' track record/testimonials
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bestselling Author advertises 'We've helped 400+ writers get book agents and/or traditional publishers' and lists notable author outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When paying for coaching or consulting, evaluate the provider's track record, testimonials, and client outcomes as part of your selection criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use interviews and tips from successful authors
rubrics_metrics.description: The page offers 'Interviews/Tips from Successful Authors' across genres (children's, fiction, memoir, nonfiction categories listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use practitioner interviews and genre-specific tips as practical guidance for crafting submissions and understanding what agents look for in that genre.
